title: Doppelganger Campaign
excerpt: Russian operation that cloned European news sites to spread anti-Ukraine fakes; sanctioned by the EU and U.S., which tie it to the Kremlin.
excerptEs: Operación rusa que clonaba webs de medios europeos para difundir bulos contra Ucrania; sancionada por la UE y EE. UU., que la vinculan al Kremlin.
